scope.summary: Implement fail-closed demo data onboarding and an owner-only existing-venue loader; record known CI and hosted-isolation blockers without claiming feature acceptance.
implemented: Added setup sample-team and post-onboarding owner loader gated by explicit deployment configuration, matching Supabase project identification and database-side approval.
Added tagged fictional FOH/BOH employees, availability, published rosters, attendance/correction and illustrative payroll-preparation examples with idempotent and existing-record protections.
Added database authorization, provenance, audit and safeguards against demo account links, invitations and payroll mapping; documented activation prerequisites and limitations.

Added the owner-provided fixes in commits 6177831 and 1801a94 for restricted provenance reads and service-role employee-update regression coverage; corrected malformed pgTAP dollar quoting found by CI.

criteria.description: Authorized development owner can choose sample team during new onboarding and can later load fictional demo data into an existing development workspace.

evidence.outcome: Both user-facing paths are implemented, but disposable database/browser verification and visible hosted-owner acceptance are not confirmed.
Passed 7/7 environment-policy and navigation tests; these do not verify live deployment acceptance.

criteria.description: Same controls remain inoperative for production, unidentified or shared customer databases, including via direct API invocation.

evidence.outcome: Application requires explicit environment/project settings; database RPC requires matching administrator approval and owner authorization. The hosted project's isolation is unverified.
Verify failed at the missing evidence-pair check before executing test/lint/build steps. Its database job failed on malformed SQL quoting at line 283; browser and tenant-isolation jobs were skipped.

criteria.description: Seed/reseed preserves real data and tenant boundaries; fictional provenance and counts are visible; repeats produce no duplicates.

evidence.outcome: Migration and regression coverage implement clean-venue refusal, tenant-scoped provenance, idempotent fixture loading and counts. All 42 pgTAP assertions passed in CI, but a malformed SQL quote at line 283 caused the test process to fail; that quote is corrected in this working tree and awaits rerun.
The most recent local attempt exited before database setup because Supabase CLI 2.122.0 was unavailable; local database verification is not claimed.

criteria.description: No outbound invitations, messages or payroll execution, including Xero, are triggered by demo records.

evidence.outcome: Synthetic account-link, invitation and payroll-mapping protections and payroll-input exclusions are implemented. Owner-added pgTAP assertions ran, but the test process failed on malformed quoting in the final service-role regression; it has been corrected and awaits rerun.
Owner-added pgTAP coverage includes the blocked demo employee account-link case; no external provider was used. The CI test process failed on malformed quoting in the final regression query.

criteria.description: Targeted and required CI pass; the completed PR documents deployment verification and operator activation steps.

evidence.outcome: Verify failed because the paired PR evidence files were missing. The database job also failed on malformed SQL quoting at line 283 after 42 assertions passed; browser and tenant-isolation jobs were skipped.
Operator activation prerequisites and user-facing behavior/limitations are documented, but hosted project verification and required green checks are outstanding.

tests.result: Local run stopped before database setup: Supabase CLI 2.122.0 was unavailable. CI run 43961540531 executed the assertions but exited 3 because malformed SQL quoting at line 283 prevented TAP plan output; the query has since been corrected and awaits CI rerun.

tests.command: Authenticated tenant-isolation and browser regression in GitHub Actions
tests.result: Both steps were skipped after the database job failed; no tenant-isolation or browser result is claimed.

decisions: Keep the PR draft and issue #273 open until disposable database/browser validation and live development-app owner acceptance pass.
Do not activate demo loading against the hosted project until its Supabase isolation and administrative approval are independently verified.
Do not use an auto-close keyword for this partial and unverified delivery.
limitations: CI found malformed SQL quoting at line 283 of the new pgTAP test. It is corrected in this working tree but has not yet been rerun.
Authenticated tenant-isolation and browser regression were skipped after the database job failed.
The hosted development Supabase project has not been verified or changed; no claim of live functionality is made.
Required Verify and database checks are not green.
blockers: Re-run CI to verify the SQL quote correction, then confirm pgTAP, tenant-isolation and browser regressions pass on the latest head.
Verify the hosted development Supabase project is dedicated and isolated, then obtain explicit operator approval before activation.
Re-run required Verify after the paired evidence files are committed and keep issue #273 open for owner-visible acceptance.
